geometry_definition: For each unique actual leading-measurement wafer, obtain its detector-element surface transform and true fitted state global position. Transform position by inverse wafer transform. Record absolute local-normal distance in mm; accept as an on-plane position only if finite and <=1e-6mm (numerical geometry tolerance, no radius or physics compatibility selection). Require wafer rigid transform roundtrip and linked leading PRD local/global consistency <=1e-8mm. Dimension2/key3 COT is allowed here only as a locX-containing detector measurement; never declare its entire covariance calibrated.
candidate_definition: Exclude leading-owned actual PRD objects. For other-owned/unassigned actual clusters on a unique supported wafer require exact detector/measurement surface transform/basis equality,valid native rdoList/wafer/strip,finite nonsentinel locX,local-to-global roundtrip <=1e-8mm. Compute dx_mm=cluster_native_locX - inverse_wafer_transform(actual_state_global_position).x. Do not subtract curvilinear locX, import/rotate/refit/repair covariance, divide by sigma, or treat dx as an association probability/pull.
